name: light-beam
title: Light Beam
description: A soft cone of light falling into a dark section from an edge, the way a stage light picks out a speaker. It draws the eye to the headline under it and gives a flat surface depth. It does not move: the light is part of the set, not an event.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/light-beam

Installed to `components/ui/effects/light-beam.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/light-beam';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/light-beam

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
